cosvoice.note: CosVoice hosted MCP server. OAuth 2.1: on first connection the owner signs in to CosVoice in the browser and clicks Allow (no API key to paste). Tools: get_account, search_numbers, create_line (setup), place_call, book_reservation, get_call, list_calls, send_text, list_messages, list_emails, get_email, list_contacts, add_contact, get_settings, update_settings, set_webhook, list_history, recent_activity, ack_instructions, list_integrations.
